start_after: HFCO_READY, controller > 0, actual proxy poll success and two distinct active slots verified
send_using: Existing xinput-test.controller.Session.set; each controls object is a complete desired frame, omitted fields return zero. Keep heartbeat running. No OS input or virtual device.
clock: Root records monotonic and wall timestamps for every Session.set, proxy packet and phase. Do not directly subtract Lua Isaac.GetTime from proxy Unix milliseconds without explicit synchronization.
finally: Set neutral and keep lease until fixture DONE or bounded failure; root then closes only this session and cleans isolated proxy overrides.
not_covered: Physical controller or Steam Input latency
